description: This file defines API routes for a memory match card game backend using FastAPI. It includes data models for game creation, deck retrieval, and matching cards, along with route handlers that invoke methods from an internal service to manage game state, create new games, get decks, and process match attempts.

classes.name: CreateGameRequest
classes.description: Body model for creating a new game session, with optional difficulty and seed.

classes.name: CreateGameResponse
classes.description: Response model containing game metadata after creation, including gameId, seed, difficulty, and deck details.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Model representing individual cards in the deck, exposing only id and value.

classes.name: MatchRequest
classes.description: Request payload containing two card IDs to attempt a match.

classes.name: MatchResponse
classes.description: Response indicating whether the match was successful, remaining pairs, moves, and completion status.

methods.name: CreateGameResponse create_game(payload: CreateGameRequest = Body(default=CreateGameRequest()))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new game with optional difficulty and seed.

methods.name: List[Card] get_deck(gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current game deck (ids and face values).

methods.name: MatchResponse post_match( gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"), payload: MatchRequest = Body(...), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to attempt to match two cards by their IDs.
